The wings are held open but slightly angled, displaying a uniform dark brown coloration with faint, lighter-colored spots (ocelli) and scalloped edges. The body is fuzzy and dark, positioned centrally between the wings. The background consists of blurred green leaves and stems.

The background foliage has an unnatural, smudged quality typical of AI-generated depth-of-field, rather than optical bokeh. Some leaf structures seem to merge illogically.
